args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently links to 'http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=...', which is not accessible to users. This change updates the email template to use the correct base URL for the password reset link, ensuring that users receive a valid link for resetting their passwords.
